name: distance_between_objects

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DistanceBetweenObjects resolves two stack object IDs with func_001EAB00, computes sqrt((x_b-x_a)^2 + (y_b-y_a)^2 + (z_b-z_a)^2) from their position fields, decrements stackTop by one, and replaces the remaining value with the integer distance

notes: The direct stackTop decrement alone resembles a one-input command, but the handler reads two values and leaves one result. Both JP calls immediately store the result and compare it against distance 200.
